notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome tab, same-origin fetch() from https://addresshome.com/ (www redirects to bare domain, used as canonical). robots.txt: generic 'User-agent: * / Allow: /', no Claude-specific disallow. Shopify storefront. Enumerated all 307 published collections via /collections.json (paged), then keyword-filtered handles/titles for furniture terms (furniture, table, chair, bench, sofa, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, dresser, shelv, bookcase, seating, nightstand, armchair, trolley, ottoman, pouf, recliner, couch, loveseat, daybed, sideboard, console, nest). Matches beyond kitchen/textile/lighting noise (bedspreads-euros, bed-linen, table-lamps, table-runners-placemats, tableware, desk-accessories -- all excluded, non-furniture): furniture, benches-pouffes, coffee-tables, console-tables, nest-of-tables, pouffes-tables, side-tables, trolley-butler-trays. Cross-checked against the homepage mega-menu's own Furniture department links, which list exactly 6 leaf collections (console-tables, coffee-tables, side-tables, nest-of-tables, benches-pouffes, trolley-butler-trays) plus the 'Designer Furniture Store' View-All link (/collections/furniture) -- confirming a flat, single-level Furniture department with no intermediate grouping nodes, so no is_group rows are needed. 'furniture' (34 items) is the View-All rollup of those 6 leaves (33/34 items match the leaf union; the 1 non-matching item, 'Le Feu Eye Mocca Black & Gold Fireplace', is a fireplace with no dedicated collection and is out of furniture scope) -- excluded per the never-extract-View-All rule (brief section 3). 'pouffes-tables' (2 items) is a byte-for-byte duplicate of 'benches-pouffes' (2 items, same 2 product IDs) and is NOT linked from the mega-menu (an orphan legacy collection) -- dropped to avoid double-counting, keeping only the mega-menu's own 'Benches & Pouffes' node. 'nest-of-tables' and 'side-tables' share only 1 of their combined 16 items (a clock table cross-tagged in both), so both were kept as genuinely distinct site nodes. Qty method: this is the same Shopify storefront as the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c291), which established that collection pages render NO 'N items' listing header (confirmed again by loading /collections/console-tables directly and reading its text -- no count text anywhere, only filter/sort controls). Verified same on this pass. Per Rule 2, used /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 enumeration of unique product IDs as the qty source; every included collection returned within a single unpaginated page (max 12 items), so each count is exact and exhaustive, not an estimate. Sanity checks: h1/page title on console-tables matched the requested node; counts are small integers, not round/suspicious; no two leaf collections other than the confirmed clock-table item share meaningful overlap. 'Trolley & Butler Trays' kept as furniture per project scope (bar cabinet + butler trays with stand = trolley-type furniture, matches brief's explicit INCLUDE example). All 5 items in it inspected by title: 1 bar cabinet + 4 butler trays (one 'with stand'), all furniture-typed, none decorative-tray/kitchenware. Excluded as non-furniture and not re-litigated here (same conclusions as the prior Home-Decor pass on this identical site): Lighting, Mirrors, Clocks (standalone), Wall Decor, Glassware, Kitchen & Dining, Decorative Accessories, Candleware, Office & Den Decor (desk-accessories retained as office decor, not furniture), Bed Linen/textiles, Tableware. No mattresses, no standalone storage boxes, no bathroom furniture, no outdoor furniture found anywhere in the 307-collection catalog -- Address Home's furniture assortment is a small side line limited to occasional/accent tables (console, coffee, side, nest), pouffes/benches, and bar trolleys/butler trays; no sofas, chairs, beds, wardrobes, desks, or dining sets exist on this storefront.
